name: gsea_running
description: The fgsea running sum of the top 6 GSEA sets (smallest q_value, then largest |nes|, collection, term; p_value NA excluded), one row per ranked TU, for V14(a) (GIAP_SPEC.md §10.2; docs/specs/M9-17-plot-support-analysis.md). Written by the function step. Not a result table.

fields.name: rank_position
fields.description: 1-based position of the TU in fgsea's ranking

fields.name: score
fields.description: The median-centred TU score fgsea ranked (ADR-0028); non-increasing in rank_position

fields.name: in_set
fields.description: Whether the TU is a member of the set

fields.name: running_es
fields.description: fgsea's running enrichment score after this position (scoreType std, gseaParam 1); its max deviation from 0 is the set's es
